chunks: Salih ibn Sa'id narrated from Yunus, from some of his companions, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him: What is the reason that when a man divorces his wife while he is ill, in a state of causing harm, she inherits from him but he does not inherit from her?
He عليه السلام said: It is because of the harm. The meaning of harm here is his preventing her from her inheritance from him, so inheritance was imposed as a punishment.

key_terms.الْعِلَّةُ: the legal cause or rationale behind a ruling
key_terms.عُقُوبَةً: as a punishment or legal penalty
key_terms.فِي حَالِ الْإِضْرَارِ: in a state of intentional harm
key_terms.مَرِيضٌ: being ill, especially in a context affecting legal rulings

ai.seo_question: Why does a wife inherit from a husband who divorces her during illness, while he does not inherit from her?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the legal reasoning behind the rule that a wife may still inherit from a husband who divorces her during a fatal illness if the divorce was meant to harm her. The Imam عليه السلام states that this ruling serves as a punishment for the husband’s attempt to deprive her of her rightful inheritance.
